{
  "name": "tokens-cli",

  "type": "module",
  "main": "./dist/index.js",
  "bin": {
    "tokens": "./bin.js"
  },
  "files": [
    "bin.js",
    "dist/**/*"
  ],
  "publishConfig": {
    "registry": "https://registry.npmjs.org/",
    "access": "public"

  "repository": {
